definition: A position of controlling influence or greater power over others.
author: William Makepeace Thackeray
quote: By which magnanimous speech he not only saved his conqueror a whipping, but got back all his ascendancy over the boys which his defeat had nearly cost him.
example_sentence: The young striker's ascendancy over the veterans was swift.
